component.name: mint-helper
component.summary: The Linux Mint desktop companion and post-installation manager

description.p: mint-helper is a modern, lightweight, and trustworthy desktop companion designed for Linux Mint. It streamlines initial post-installation tasks such as browser setup, media codecs, Microsoft-compatible fonts, LibreOffice tabbed layout configuration, firewall protection, and system health checks.

Beyond the first setup, mint-helper serves as an ongoing maintenance station: monitor real hardware usage, audit Flatpak permissions, clean unused package caches safely, verify Timeshift snapshots, and manage system updates.

screenshot.caption: mint-helper Overview Dashboard on Linux Mint Cinnamon

description.p: Initial release of mint-helper featuring the 8-step Post Installation wizard, Real SysInfo Dashboard, Maintenance Center, and Timeshift recovery verification.
